newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI sells shares in three firms.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI sells shares in three firms.

text.p: Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) said on Wednesday it had sold shares of three firms, each exceeding 1.9 percent of their respective capital.
It sold 4.825 million shares of Narmada Cement Company Ltd, representing 9.5 percent of its capital, at 32.47 rupees a share, ICICI said in a statement.
The Narmada Cement share closed on Wednesday at 13.25 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
ICICI did not say when the sale was effected.
It also sold 381,300 shares, or 1.94 percent of Global Telesystems Ltd's capital, at 100 rupees a share, and 140,591 shares of Amal Products Ltd, representing two percent of its capital.
ICICI, which is a leading term lending institution, said the sales were done through buy-back arrangements with promoters or by negotiated sale with big investment institutions.
